$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
Set-Location $repo
git fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
$rows=@()
$refs=@(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/remotes/origin)
foreach($ref in $refs){
  if(($ref -eq 'origin/main') -or ($ref -eq 'origin/HEAD') -or (-not $ref.StartsWith('origin/'))){continue}
  $branch=$ref.Substring(7)
  $counts=((git rev-list --left-right --count "origin/main...$ref" | Out-String).Trim() -split '\s+')
  $ahead=[int]$counts[1]; $behind=[int]$counts[0]
  git merge-base --is-ancestor $ref origin/main 2>$null
  $ancestor=($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0)
  git diff --quiet origin/main $ref 2>$null
  $treeEqual=($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0)
  $ch=@(git cherry origin/main $ref 2>$null)
  $plus=@($ch|Where-Object{$_.StartsWith('+')}).Count
  $minus=@($ch|Where-Object{$_.StartsWith('-')}).Count
  $meta=(git show -s --format='%cI|%H|%s' $ref | Out-String).Trim() -split '\|',3
  $rows += [ordered]@{branch=$branch;ahead=$ahead;behind=$behind;ancestor=$ancestor;tree_equal=$treeEqual;cherry_plus=$plus;cherry_minus=$minus;date=$meta[0];sha=$meta[1];subject=$meta[2]}
}
[ordered]@{main=(git rev-parse origin/main);current=(git branch --show-current);dirty=((git status --porcelain=v1|Out-String).Trim().Length -gt 0);branches=$rows|Sort-Object date -Descending}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
